nodes.prompt: Your wheat harvest is ready. A middleman offers ₹1,400/quintal. The mandi (market) price is ₹1,800 but you must transport it.

options.label: Store and wait for better price

nodes.prompt: You sold quickly and got ₹28,000. But you left ₹8,000 on the table by not going to the mandi.
nodes.lesson: [Skill Tested: Negotiation] Always compare prices at multiple buyers. The mandi price is publicly listed on e-NAM (National Agriculture Market app).

nodes.prompt: After ₹2,000 transport cost you earned ₹34,000 — ₹6,000 more than the middleman offer!
nodes.lesson: Transporting to the mandi took extra effort but yielded 21% more income. Collective transport with other farmers reduces cost further.

nodes.prompt: Prices fell further. You paid ₹1,500 storage and still sold for ₹1,400.
nodes.lesson: Storing grain requires proper facilities and market intelligence. Without these, waiting often leads to losses.
